ai_summary: Aeroflex Neu Limited, a material subsidiary of Aeroflex Enterprises Limited, has completed the acquisition of a controlling 51.01% equity stake in Stilonn Valves and Controls Private Limited, making Stilonn its new subsidiary. This strategic move is aimed at establishing an integrated platform within the high-growth AI Infra and Data Centre sector, significantly expanding the company's capabilities in critical engineering solutions. While the announcement does not detail specific financial terms, no immediate red flags are evident regarding the transaction itself.
